lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Correction and reflection: reflecting without shame

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy Ready for Life elementary sequence — Grade 3
Ready for Life v1 safety, supervision, and no-shame policy reference
Manuel Academy RFL G3 Unit 6 — family contribution capstone
Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice reflecting without shame. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: In a private space, the learner writes or draws answers to the three reflection prompts about their own completed helper job, without a guardian reading the specific content.
safetyNotes: No heat, sharp tools, or chemical cleaners are used during this lesson; it is a private written or drawn reflection.

The guardian does not read or require disclosure of the learner's private written reflection; guardian confirmation covers only that the reflection was completed and which prompt the learner found most useful, not its content.

simulationAlternative.description: If the private reflection moment did not happen right after the job because time or a private space was not available, the learner instead completes a short written or drawn walkthrough of how the reflection would go, covering the same three prompts, and the guardian confirms afterward, as discussed together, that the walkthrough happened.

materials: learner-local: private writing or drawing space

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Rewrite that one 'do differently' idea as a specific plan for next time, naming exactly what you would change, the same way useful information turns into a better next step rather than something to apologize for.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Reflection specificity: Each of the three prompts is answered with a specific, concrete detail from the actual job. | Non-shaming language: The reflection describes specific steps or moments without using self-judgment words. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner write one sentence of encouragement they would give a friend who forgot the same step they did, then compare that sentence to how they first described their own moment, noticing any difference in tone.

resources.title: reflecting without shame worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: In a private space, the learner writes or draws answers to the three reflection prompts about their own completed helper job, without a guardian reading the specific content.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact reflecting without shame decision or action.
Model move 2: Before writing, sit quietly for a moment and picture the whole job from start to finish, step by step.
Model move 3: Write your private reflection using all three prompts, checking off each part as you finish it.

Model check: Reflection specificity: Each of the three prompts is answered with a specific, concrete detail from the actual job. | Non-shaming language: The reflection describes specific steps or moments without using self-judgment words.

resources.title: reflecting without shame action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for reflecting without shame.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-guided-card.
4. Complete the chosen route on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-independent-card.
5. Save the small record on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-evidence-record; use swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-retry-pair if a step is missed.

resources.title: reflecting without shame coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: In a private space, the learner writes or draws answers to the three reflection prompts about their own completed helper job, without a guardian reading the specific content.
Coach direction: Before writing, sit quietly for a moment and picture the whole job from start to finish, step by step.
Learner prompt: Name one moment from the job, big or small, that you remember clearly right now.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: reflecting without shame complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Write your private reflection using all three prompts, checking off each part as you finish it. No one else needs to read what you write unless you choose to share it.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I wrote about one specific thing that went as planned, naming the exact part, not just 'it went fine.'
Response 2 (t2-p2): I wrote about one specific thing to do differently next time, describing it as useful information for next time, not as a mistake to feel bad about.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I named one specific skill from this unit (choosing, listing, safety-checking, doing, or checking) that I feel most confident using again.
Response 4 (t2-p4): I kept my full written reflection private, sharing only that it is finished.

Equal-access rule: If the private reflection moment did not happen right after the job because time or a private space was not available, the learner instead completes a short written or drawn walkthrough of how the reflection would go, covering the same three prompts, and the guardian confirms afterward, as discussed together, that the walkthrough happened.

resources.title: reflecting without shame minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.

Reflection: Rewrite that one 'do differently' idea as a specific plan for next time, naming exactly what you would change, the same way useful information turns into a better next step rather than something to apologize for.

Success checks: Reflection specificity: Each of the three prompts is answered with a specific, concrete detail from the actual job. | Non-shaming language: The reflection describes specific steps or moments without using self-judgment words.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: reflecting without shame supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional reflecting without shame condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Reflection specificity: Each of the three prompts is answered with a specific, concrete detail from the actual job. | Non-shaming language: The reflection describes specific steps or moments without using self-judgment words..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

realRoute.title: reflecting without shame — permitted real-life route
realRoute.permissionRule: Do not begin the physical action until a household-authorized guardian gives permission and is available for the supervision or review named in this lesson.
steps: Confirm the setting, materials, and stop condition before acting.
Write your private reflection using all three prompts, checking off each part as you finish it. No one else needs to read what you write unless you choose to share it.
Complete the response prompts on the delivered independent card without recording private identifying details.
Check the result against the delivered evidence record and correct any missed step.
realRoute.completionCondition: The learner submits the minimal process record; only the household-authorized guardian attests that the named physical action occurred.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Reflection specificity: Each of the three prompts is answered with a specific, concrete detail from the actual job. | Non-shaming language: The reflection describes specific steps or moments without using self-judgment words.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l06-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Give permission; provide only the supervision, handling, review, or observation named in the lesson; attest only that the physical event occurred.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
